name: muse
description: Run the entire Muse stack (API, worker, frontend) with one command.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hifi,api,worker,web -c green,blue,magenta,cyan "cd hifi-api && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Backend run worker" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix Backend run build && npm --prefix Frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix Backend run lint && npm --prefix Frontend run lint
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
